decisions.reason: As a publicly emphasized flagship product with repeated gold-award recognition and a close fit to the firm's traditional seasonal core, management is very unlikely to withdraw it.

Although another bread variant could still be rationalized after earlier portfolio pruning, its continued dedicated presentation since launch and its close fit with the core bakery offer support continued commitment.

This product is close to the firm's established Christmas confectionery business and has remained visibly supported on its own page, so management would likely continue it unless results clearly deteriorate.
